notes.title: Additional update notes for Halloween 2021 release (build 1.0.14c)
notes.content: Fixed a small issue that prevented "Costumes Found" stat from working correctly, which also blocked certain achievements from unlocking. Stat should show correctly, and these achievements should unlock now.

notes.title: Update notes for Halloween 2021 build 1.0.14
notes.content: Fixed a small issue that prevented certain achievements from unlocking for people returning with save files from previous versions. These achievements should unlock now.

notes.title: v1.0.10 Update Out
notes.content:
Update out today to fix a progress-halting issue some players were experiencing.

v1.0.10 Patch Notes

Bugs:
--Fixed issue where Seamstress' key could get stuck in walls in certain situations

notes.title: v1.0.9 Update Out
notes.content:
Update out today that adds an ULTRA BLOOD option to game settings. Turn it on to make everything bleed more! Have fun, and don't forget to wear a raincoat! :) -Trevor

v1.0.9 Patch Notes

Features
--"Ultra Blood" option added to game settings

Visuals:
--Did I mention the option for more blood???
--Gibs now emit some blood in normal mode

Bugs:
--Fixed issue with Jack overlay not showing correctly in certain Glowing Hills map

notes.title: v1.0.8 Update Out
notes.content:
Patch out today that turns up the wasteland violence! Monster hearts now beat and blood sprays from loosed organ locations, plus a bunch of small fixes and a new Easter egg... Go forth and shred the wastes! Have a bloody good time! :) -Trevor

v1.0.8 Patch Notes

Visuals:
--Monster heart/heart-like organs now beat
--Added blood spray at locations where monster organs fall out
--Monster organs now cast a slight shadow to help their depth stand out a bit more
--Particle effects on ballistic miss now show further from attack location
--Fixed issue with some monster gallery shadows not showing at correct height
--Fixed issue with Splutlet’s gallery shadow
--Small updates to some structure sprites

Bugs:
--Fixed issue with miss ‘X’ not showing in correct location in certain combat galleries

Other:
--Lodged in the muck, an ancient relic has appeared, holding within it the echo of a long-lost cautionary ballad...

notes.title: v1.0.6 Patch Out
notes.content:
Patch out today that includes Fast Combat option, separate SFX/Music volume, and makes Zar even more fun to use! Go forth and decimate the wastes! -Trevor

v1.0.6 Patch Notes

Features:
--Fast Combat option added. Decreases many time delays in combat for those that like faster pace of play.
--SFX and Music volume controls now separated
--Game Options now have their own overlay
--NPCs now have a short period where player cannot talk to them after conversation ends. This should help prevent player from unintentionally running into NPC after just talking with them.

Weapons:
--Zar crosshair and line markers updated to increase readability and help keep track of end of line
--If Zar attack misses, pattern now remains on screen so you don’t have to draw it again - but you never miss, right??? :)

Passives:
--Updated Misery Eater and Suture Spider description to improve clarity

Text:
--Increased size of quest guidance text in lower left of in-game menu

Bugs:
--Fixed issue where using adrenaline to gain action did not reset “Low on TIme” cursor status for weapons that cost 2 actions to use
--Fixed bad transfer control in Act 4 approach map - put player outside boundaries

notes.title: v1.0.5 Patch Out
notes.content:
v1.0.5 Patch Notes

Features:
--Pressing Shift while buying ammo and some utility items will now buy the maximum amount the player can afford
--Jack now has a visibility highlight when moving behind foreground walls in the map - the star of the show always has to be visible! :)

Monsters:
--Small balances to final boss fight

Visuals:
--Minor change to up/down menu arrow
--Minor cosmetic updates to some weapon crosshairs

Text:
--Added tool tip text for player adrenaline gauge and stat bonus tracker
--Added text to bonus food item descriptions to make it clearer their effect is permanent
--Added text to knife holster description and store upgrade descriptions to make it clearer monster meat yield bonus is passive
--Mutant Gauntlet store description now says “Fist Pattern” instead of “Punch Pattern”
--Mutant Gauntlet holster description now refers to “left/right fist” pattern instead of “mirror pattern” to increase clarity
--Tool tip text for some dashboard elements should now show with buffer from screen edge
--Added % values to Ballistic Shield item holster description

Passives:
--Ballistic Shield Dodge debuff decreased from 10% to 5%

Bugs:
--Fixed issue where Quake Cannon weapon would disappear from store. Weapon should now show up for players who experienced bug in previous build.
--Fixed issue where Act 4 miniboss could drop key in inaccessible location
--When Auto Holster or Auto Pouch equipped, tool tip text when hovering over affected weapon/item holster now correctly reads “Free Swap” instead of “-1 TU”
--Fixed issue where monster accessory item in final boss battle was incorrectly affecting player stat modifiers

notes.title: v1.0.4 Patch Out
notes.content:
Patch out today that adds new achievements, a subtitles option, and fixes several bugs. Have a great weekend in the wasteland! -Trevor

v1.0.4 Patch Notes

Visuals:
--Changed color/speed of stitched door sprite to make it stand out more

Options:
--Added Subtitles option to game menus for displaying subtitles during animated cutscenes

Achievements:
--Added 6 new Steam achievements. Most of them should be awarded on save game load if you’ve already completed them.

Bugs:
--Fixed crash that could occur when fighting certain bosses while using Deep Stone passive item
--Stilter top half no longer animates when game paused

notes.title: v1.0.3 Patch Out
notes.content:
Patch out today that fixes several bugs. Go forth and conquer the wastes! -Trevor

---

v1.0.3 Patch

Bugs:
--Fixed crash that occurred when returning to main menu while damage-over-time effect present in combat
--Fixed getting stuck on transfer between an Act 3 map
--Fixed dead-end dialog node in “Act 2 Complete” dialog
--Fixed rocket launcher swarm mode causing crash when used on enemy with blurred status effect
--Act 2 key should now be visible even if behind foreground wall when it drops
--Fixed bug where Act 2 boss could drop items so they are “stuck” inside back lair walls; any stuck items in existing save files created before fix should now be re-positioned automatically to center floor of lair so player can pick them up
--Fixed issue with last Act 2 waypoint not enabling at correct time
--Fixed issue with Larry phrases not showing on top of darkness

notes.title: v1.0.2 Patch Out
notes.content:
Small patch out today, fixing bug that sometimes prevented combat with Act 4 boss, along with some other minor issues. Have fun roaming the wastes this weekend! -Trevor
 
---
 
v1.0.2 Patch
 
Passive Items:
--Kill Sight holster button hover text now shows numeric bonus to critical chance

Skills:
--Increased base chance of gut grenade triggering

Dialog:
--Fixed bad dialog bubble tail during Jack/Larry/Cuddles conversation

Bugs:
--Fixed bug that prevented start of combat with Act 4 Boss.

notes.title: v1.0.1 Patch Out
notes.content:
Small patch out today with balance changes and fixes for some minor issues. Hope you're having fun in the wastes! -Trevor
 
---
 
v1.0.1 Patch
 
Passive Items:
--Election Stone now gives 15% bonus to weapon special chance instead of 7%
 
Damage Markers:
-- Increased max acid DoT damage
-- Increased min fire DoT damage
 
Skills:
--Increased pattern size of gut grenade blast
--Increased damage from gut grenade blast
 
SFX:
--Added some missing SFX to two grenade types
 
Map Design:
--Gave some love to maps in Act 3 and 4 that needed some attention
 
Bugs:
--Fixed issue with “prevent-Jack-getting-stuck” code
--Fixed dialog issue when talking to Act 1 Boss
--Fixed wall control on two stair instances in Act 2

notes.title: Early Access v0.45 Patch
notes.content:
Small patch out today to help new players better understand controls and gameplay systems. -Trevor

---

Early Access v0.45 Patch

Tutorial Hints:
--Added WASD UI hint in first map to help players learn movement, not expect mouse to move them
--Improved UI explanation overlay that shows during second battle, specifically to better explain monster stat gauges (upper right) and how they're tied to monster stats

notes.title: Early Access v0.44 Patch
notes.content:
Small patch out today. Fixed issue with mouse disappearing when controller plugged in and added UI hints to help players better understand combat gallery UI. -Trevor

---

Early Access v0.44 Patch

Bug Fixes:
--Mouse no longer disappears from screen when controller plugged in

Tutorial Hints:
--Added UI hints to help players learn how to use consumables (e.g., health injectors)
--Added UI hints to help players find where grenades are kept in inventory
--Adjusted dashboard overlay to account for grenade UI hint

Other:
--Changed dialog option to advance conversation from "Continue" to "(Click anywhere)". Noticed some players were clicking precisely on "Continue" to advance dialog, which is actually not necessary, unless you are training your mouse precision skills.

notes.title: OUTTA GAS: Now Available on Steam!
notes.content:
I am incredibly excited to announce that [b]OUTTA GAS[/b], my post-apocalyptic RPG, is now available for PC on Steam in Early Access! Gain immediate access to the first portion of Sucky Pond and the following content:
[list]
[*] Innovative Turn-Based SHOOTING GALLERY Combat
[*] 6 Devastating Weapons
[*] 8 Deadly Monsters
[*] 2 Hulking Minibosses
[*] Over 12 Upgrades
[*] 5 Passive Items
[*] Over 12 Unlockable Abilities
[*] Grenades and More!
[/list]

Over the next few months, additional content will regularly unlock, adding new locations, monsters, weapons, and other content. This roadmap will culminate with the full release of [b]OUTTA GAS,[/b] where four full acts, over 70 monsters, more than 25 weapons, hundreds of upgrades, and much more await you! Find the gas you need to get back on the road to the Party at the End of the World!

[b]OUTTA GAS[/b] retails for $19.99, but for the first week after launch you can enjoy a 10% discount until January 28th to celebrate this most excellent event!

Connect with the [b]OUTTA GAS[/b] community and give your feedback here on Steam or on Discord ([url=https://discord.gg/q7fscxQ]https://discord.gg/q7fscxQ[/url]). Looking forward to hearing from you!

Now go kill some wasteland monsters!

-Trevor
